theme: Light mode preference (Swiss & High-Contrast - Archetype 4) with dark mode support.

headings.instruction: Use Cabinet Grotesk for all H1-H4 headings. Apply 'tracking-tight' for sizes above 32px. Use varying font weights (e.g., font-light or font-black) for tension.

body.instruction: Use Satoshi for body text. Maintain clean, geometric legibility with normal letter spacing.

labels_overlines.instruction: MUST be Uppercase + Tiny + Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).

surface.instruction: Surfaces must have a sharp 1px border (border-black/5 or border-white/10). No soft muddy shadows. Follow 'Grid Borders' pattern for the dashboard bento grids.

primary.instruction: Monochrome default. Use Signal Red (#E53935) or Warning Yellow (#FACC15) ONLY for functional alerts (upcoming renewals, high spend).

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use Neumorphism (The Tactile Variant) selectively for toggles, and Grid Borders (Technical Look) for data-heavy dashboard sections.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px crisp borders on cards. border-border/40. Consider removing the right border on the last item of a row to create an open edge.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Hover states must have HIGHER contrast. Buttons: translate-y-[-2px] with increased shadow.

components.cards: Flat solid background, 1px subtle border, no initial shadow. On hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and subtle shadow.
components.navigation: Sidebar or visible top nav. Must use Solid Background with a hard bottom border or right border. No transparent navbars.
components.tables: Use Shadcn Table component. Dense padding for financial data. Right-align numeric columns.
components.charts: Use Recharts or Shadcn Chart. Must be color-blind friendly. Use crisp lines, minimal grid lines.
components.buttons: Sharp corners or subtle roundness (max 8px). High-contrast background.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: MODE B: High Density Grid. Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy for outer containers (p-8 to p-12). Dense padding inside data tables.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align dense data, right-align monetary values.

motion.micro_interactions: Hover, click, focus states required. Transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease.
motion.entrance: Staggered entrance for list items in the subscription table.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text. Explicitly set text color on hover.
accessibility.focus: Focus states must have HIGHER contrast (e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='upload-contract-btn').

media_and_icons.icons_library: lucide-react (default) or @phosphor-icons/react for dense financial/developer look.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize a dense, high-contrast, 'Swiss' aesthetic suitable for financial/contract management.
Use Recharts to show market comparison data visually (Current Price vs Market Price).
Ensure 'Upload Contract' (PDF) and 'Scan Gmail' buttons are highly visible primary actions.
Subscription List must support categorisation (SaaS, AI, Internet, etc.) via tabs or pills.
Implement a timeline or calendar component for upcoming renewals.
Use Shadcn UI extensively for data tables, dialogs, and selects. Customize border radius to max 8px.
Ensure all monetary values and savings percentages are visually distinct (e.g., green text for savings).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use stark contrast and structured density to look professional.
Create depth through 1px crisp borders and targeted drop shadows, NOT muddy universal shadows.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Keep reading flow natural (left-aligned).
Use modern button styles (max 8px radius) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭 for icons. Use real icons.
Include data-testid on all interactive elements.
If building components, refer to Shadcn UI practices (raw HTML/Tailwind for layouts, Shadcn for interactive logic).
